intelligence.essence: His screenshots of Supabase showed STATUS Healthy — and underneath it, POSTGRES 5,526 calls with 2,497 ERRORS, ~45% failing, red bars concentrated Nov 20 ~11am, tapering to green by Nov 21 morning. The headline said 97.0% success over 164,872 requests because edge calls (83,895, 0 errors) dominate the total. He read it right: "there's some kind of message in the screenshots that I don't understand. So there's been a change of state." And his order: "something happened and it doesn't look good. We gotta fix it." A red signal is a fix order, not an explanation prompt. "Fixed" is proven by the numbers moving — the error count falling, a real action landing in the Ledger, the Dashboard number moving — never by a code change alone.
